svg.title: Surface-wind sample: forecasts minus KPMV's reports, 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-21
svg.desc: Histograms of forecast minus reported wind speed, gust and direction for Open-Meteo's hourly, 15-minute and current 10 m wind and the NWS hour, each KPMV report once. The dashed line is zero.
svg.text: Surface-wind sample: forecasts minus KPMV's reports, 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-21
Reports per bin. Right of the dashed line the forecast was above the report, left of it below.
Each forecast as it stood while the report was the newest. Rows: Open-Meteo’s three forms, then NWS on the same reports.
